title: ～折に
shortExplanation: Indicates the time or occasion when something happens; 'when', 'at the time of'.
longExplanation: The ～折に grammar point is used in a somewhat formal register to express that one event or action takes place on the occasion of another. It essentially means 'when' or 'at the time of'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + 折に, Verb-た形 + 折に, Noun + の折に

examples.jp: 父が病気の折に、私は留学していました。
examples.romaji: Chichi ga byouki no ori ni, watashi wa ryuugaku shite imashita.
examples.en: When my father was ill, I was studying abroad.

examples.jp: 日本へ行く折に、お土産を買ってきてください。
examples.romaji: Nihon e iku ori ni, omiyage o katte kite kudasai.
examples.en: When you go to Japan, please buy souvenirs.

examples.jp: 子供が寝ている折に、静かにしてください。
examples.romaji: Kodomo ga nete iru ori ni, shizuka ni shite kudasai.
examples.en: Please be quiet when the child is sleeping.

examples.jp: 彼に会う折に、この手紙を渡してください。
examples.romaji: Kare ni au ori ni, kono tegami o watashite kudasai.
examples.en: Please give him this letter when you see him.

usageNote: Formal, literary, ceremonial "on the occasion of".

family.name: Occasion (While Doing / On The Occasion Of)
